mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, restrictive monetary policy increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals labor market strength boosting consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, declining housing starts and retail sales signal weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate trend over 3 months indicates deteriorating labor conditions that reduce consumer spending, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals severe labor market distress that reduces household income and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in federal funds rate signals economic contraction under restrictive policy, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, sustained industrial production growth signals economic rebound, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of post-shock recovery periods when INDPRO increases.
